A '''Twi'lek Jedi General''' served the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. [[Gender/Legends|She]] was [[Death/Legends|killed]] in [[Battle of Malsuum|battle]] while leading a [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] charge on [[Malsuum]]. [[Hock Malsuum|CT-5539]] picked up her body and continued the charge. Hock later reflected on her death, thinking that while [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] were fearless warriors, they were still capable of making mistakes. The [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] was a [[Rutian/Legends|Rutian]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]].<ref name="Cry of Shadows" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Twi'lek Jedi General appears in the flashback portion of the [[2013]] [[Dark Horse Comics|Dark Horse]] comic [[Darth Vader and the Cry of Shadows 1|''Darth Vader and the Cry of Shadows'' 1]].
